status: source-backed chronology; NOT territorial polygon layer
notes: A shared monarch is not a single unified government; no retroactive UK label.
Transfer of authority for one colony/company is not equivalent to all colonial territories being administered identically.
Ireland’s political relationship cannot be accurately coded by modern border fills across the whole timeline.
A historical year tag is not the same as a full-year effective-control claim.

events.name_zh: 伊丽莎白一世授予东印度公司贸易特许状
events.after: East India Company chartered under Crown of England
events.assertion: Company established as legally privileged trader, NOT automatically exercising territorial control over India.

events.name_zh: 英格兰与苏格兰共戴一位君主
events.before: Kingdom of England and Kingdom of Scotland separate monarchs
events.assertion: Parliaments and constitutions remained distinct; neither all Scottish colonial enterprise nor English laws can be relabelled simply 'UK'.

events.name_zh: 英格兰与苏格兰王国组成大不列颠王国
events.before: Kingdom of England; Kingdom of Scotland
events.assertion: State level changed by statutory union; colonial control geometry still needs each colony's own historical evidence.

events.name_zh: 大不列颠与爱尔兰议会联合生效
events.before: Kingdom of Great Britain and Kingdom of Ireland
events.after: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland
events.assertion: Parliamentary incorporation legal change, not evidence that everyone or every rural district obeyed identical central administration.

events.name_zh: 印度主要公司统治权移交英国王室
events.before: East India Company governments in territories under its administration
events.assertion: Transfer of government and revenues of Company territories to Crown; other princely states and treaties must be categorized separately.

events.name_zh: 爱尔兰自由邦根据1921年条约成立
events.before: UK and differing governance in Irish jurisdictions
events.after: Irish Free State, a Dominion, with Northern Ireland distinct and treaty-retained British port rights
events.assertion: Avoid simplistic instant fully independent map of the whole island in 1921; treaty effect and constitutional form differ.
